Results.ReviewText:
Love it so far.  Gets plenty hot to cook in just a few minutes.

I've purchased $200 grills that lasted 2 years, $100 grills that lasted 1-2 years, I've replaced burners on those cheap grills to get another 1-2 years.  

It was time again to replace the whole unit.  I have several friends that brag about their Weber grills.  So I decided to try one out.  At 2 times the cost of a cheap grill, I certainly expect this to last much longer.

Love it so far.  It was pre-assembled by my local Aubuchon Hardware and the build quality and quality of materials is certainly better than the average grill. 

Only problem so far was the ignitor would not work the other day, replaced the battery and still nothing.  Ended up being a loose wire connection, that just needed to be pushed all the way in.

2 burner warm up quickly and has plenty of space for my family of 5 (3 teenage boys).

Bring on Summer!
Results.Title: New Weber Spirit II E-210 Grill

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
